notes: Both maps are now much more alive. Each run has a new random layout of landmarks, pots, crates and buried treasure to find.
Random events can pop up during a run: Ember Rain, a Vault Thief to chase down, a Hunt, thick Fog, a Swarm and a mysterious Altar.
Find the Spirit Shrine on each map and pick a free blessing. Claim landmarks (stone circles, forges, crypts and more) for rewards.
Gloomwood has new monsters: Puffcaps, Hornets, Shamans, Lurkers, Goblin Thieves and a new mini-boss, The Hollow Stag.
The Ashen Citadel is now a fire-and-metal fortress with its own monsters: Cinderhounds, Pyromancers, Slags that split, Automatons, Gargoyles and a new boss, The Molten Tyrant.
New weather and details on both maps: fireflies, mist and blood moons in Gloomwood, smoke and embers in the Citadel.
The Armory has 24 new talents, including a whole new fourth tree, Wayfarer, with talents for treasure, events and shrines. Reset still refunds every shard.
Old saves keep all their talents and progress.
